summary: Implemented the feature in the repository without committing and without running tests or repo code. New: monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver), monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), and the plot_2d_or_3d_image function in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Changed: nifti_writer default dtype to np.float32; SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler are now thin adapters over the savers and plot function (output_dir, filename, and index parameters added as specified). Callers updated: unet_evaluation_array.py, unet_evaluation_dict.py, integration_sliding_window.py (output_path to output_dir), and test_handler_classification_saver.py (passes filename). New tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Static checks only: no lines over 120 characters, no trailing whitespace, single trailing newline in each file. Nothing was executed, so flake8 and all tests remain unverified and need running before merge.
